_doc: Ink pieces cut from the public-domain engravings in assets/engravings/source (sources.tsv). box = crop as fractions of the source image [x0, y0, x1, y1]; mask = feathered ellipse filling the crop (the classic vignette fade) or none; feather as a fraction of the crop's short side; levels = ink coverage remapped from [lo, hi] to [0, 1]. scripts/ink_extract.py writes assets/engravings/ink/<name>.png (8-bit ink coverage: 255 = full ink). The C1 pieces are rest poses only; cutting the figures into hinged puppets comes after C1.

progress.role: Progress (the Founder), rest pose; the spear becomes a torch when the puppet is cut

prudence.role: Prudence (the Board), rest pose: the seated Justice figure

mercury.role: Mercury (the Lawyer), rest pose: the flying putto with winged helmet and caduceus

cherubs.role: The cherub choir, rest pose: three putti

laborer.role: The engraved laborer, lower corner; never moves
